garden.hint.named: Decided by nine cells — the eight around it and itself. Nobody touches it.
garden.hint.wild: Nobody has named this rule. What happens today, nobody knows.
garden.line.today: Today’s rule is {rule} ({code}). The seeds are down; nobody touches it now.
garden.event.extinct: By generation {gen}, no one was left.
garden.event.frozen: Nothing has changed since generation {gen}. It set.
garden.event.cycle: It returns to the same shape every {v} generations. Like breathing.
garden.event.bloom: At generation {gen} it suddenly grew {v}× larger.
garden.event.drift: Generation {gen} — something is drifting to one side.
garden.event.steady: {gen} generations in, and no one has died.
garden.event.noise: Generation {gen} — the shapes have scattered. From here it is just noise.
garden.event.crowded: Generation {gen} — the board is full. Nowhere left to grow.
garden.dex.title: {n} kinds found
garden.dex.osc: {n} cells · returns to itself every {p} generations
garden.rd.seeded: Fresh reagents fell into the tank. (seed {n})
garden.rd.hint: Two chemicals spread and consume each other. Nobody drew the dots or lines.
garden.rd.today: Today's tank is set to {name}. Tiny spots begin to grow.
garden.rd.event.spots: Reaction {n} — small spots appeared across the tank.
garden.rd.event.joined: Reaction {n} — separate lines have begun to join.
garden.rd.event.front: Reaction {n} — the advancing pattern crossed half the tank.
garden.rd.event.settled: Reaction {n} — the pattern barely moves now. It will keep this shape for a while.
garden.pl.name: Particle Life
garden.pl.seeded: A new web of forces was set. (world {n})
garden.pl.hint: Up close they repel; farther away each color attracts or rejects. Nobody leads.
garden.pl.today: Today's attractions and repulsions are set. Five species begin to notice one another.
garden.pl.event.cluster: Movement {n} — scattered particles formed their first large colony.
garden.pl.event.ring: Movement {n} — a ring appeared, leaving its center empty.
garden.pl.event.separated: Movement {n} — the colors separated into different territories.
garden.pl.event.collapse: Movement {n} — a large colony collapsed and scattered at once.
garden.ph.name: Physarum Dish
garden.ph.seeded: Food was placed in a fresh dish. (dish {n})
garden.ph.hint: Each point senses only ahead and to either side. Its trail lingers as scent, then fades.
garden.ph.today: The slime wakes at the center. Nobody knows the paths between five food sources yet.
garden.ph.event.connected: Move {n} — every food source joined one network for the first time.
garden.ph.event.pruned: Move {n} — unused branches are fading, leaving shorter paths behind.
garden.ph.event.damaged: Move {n} — the path through the middle of the dish was cut.
garden.ph.event.repaired: Move {n} — it went around the break and connected every food source again.
garden.ce.name: Cyclic Ecosystem
garden.ce.seeded: The territories of five species were divided again. (world {n})
garden.ce.hint: One yields to two, two to three, and the last back to one. Nothing stays strongest forever.
garden.ce.today: Five species chase one another's tails. Today's borders begin to move.
garden.ce.event.reversal: Generation {n} — species {species} displaced the leader and took the largest territory.
garden.ce.event.spiral: Generation {n} — three borders curled around one point and a spiral was born.
garden.ce.event.extinct: Generation {n} — one species lost its territory completely.
garden.ce.event.balance: Generation {n} — no species holds even a quarter of the board. A balance has formed.
garden.st.name: Falling Sand Terrarium
garden.st.code: sand · water · soil · plants · fire · smoke
garden.st.seeded: The terrain and a small pond were made again. (terrarium {n})
garden.st.hint: Rain falls on its own, wet sand becomes soil, and plants grow toward water.
garden.st.today: Plants grow beside a small pond. Rain will come, and eventually lightning too.
garden.st.event.flood: Change {n} — water filled every low place and became a small flood.
garden.st.event.erosion: Change {n} — a wet slope gave way and sand flowed all at once.
garden.st.event.fire: Change {n} — the first spark caught on a plant.
garden.st.event.wildfire: Change {n} — fire passed from plant to plant through the forest.
garden.st.event.recovery: Change {n} — plants began growing again from the soil left by the fire.
garden.bd.name: Flock Sky
garden.bd.seeded: A new flock gathered in the sky. (sky {n})
garden.bd.hint: Each bird aligns with nearby neighbors, gathers without colliding, and avoids red predators.
garden.bd.today: The birds begin reading one another's motion. Two red predators circle outside.
garden.bd.event.approach: Flight {n} — a predator came right alongside the flock.
garden.bd.event.split: Flight {n} — one flock split into {f} smaller groups.
garden.bd.event.escaped: Flight {n} — they turned together and opened distance from the predator.
garden.bd.event.rejoined: Flight {n} — the scattered birds gathered into one flock again.
garden.ln.seeded: A small seed of continuous density was placed again. (seed {n})
garden.ln.hint: Every cell holds all values between on and off. A whole ring around it decides the next shape.
garden.ln.today: Today's continuous life uses {name} conditions. A body without hard edges begins to gather.
garden.ln.event.emerged: Flow {n} — scattered density gathered into one bounded body.
garden.ln.event.moving: Flow {n} — the whole body is moving while keeping its shape.
garden.ln.event.split: Flow {n} — one body separated into {c} pieces.
garden.ln.event.collapse: Flow {n} — the creature's mass fell below half at once.
garden.ln.event.steady: Flow {n} — the body barely changes now, but its shape remains.
garden.nc.seeded: A few living cells were placed at the center again. (seed {n})
garden.nc.hint: Every cell runs the same tiny neural net over itself and its neighbors. Damage erases only living state.
garden.nc.today: Today's form is {shape}. A small seed begins passing signals outward.
garden.nc.event.grown: Inference {n} — the cells filled more than 78% of the target form on their own.
garden.nc.event.damaged: Inference {n} — a round piece of the body was erased.
garden.nc.event.repaired: Inference {n} — it grew from surviving cells and recovered to {p}% of its form.
garden.nc.event.failed: Inference {n} — even after waiting, the damaged area did not recover enough.
garden.ev.name: Evolution Observatory
garden.ev.seeded: A first generation of random genomes was born again. (world {n})
garden.ev.hint: Creatures finding more green food become parents. Color marks genetically close species.
garden.ev.today: The first generation does not know how to find food. Only successful steering passes on.
garden.ev.event.generation: Generation {g} ended. Best fitness {best}, genetic diversity {d}, {s} species remain.
garden.ev.event.breakthrough: Generation {g} — lineage {id} passed the old record and reached fitness {best}.
garden.ev.event.diversityLow: Generation {g} — genetic diversity fell to {d}. One solution nearly fills the population.
garden.ev.event.speciation: Generation {g} — genetic distance split the population into {s} species.
